newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan says capital gains tax hurts economy.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan says capital gains tax hurts economy.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Wednesday said that capital gains tax is a poor revenue raiser and eliminating it would help economic activity.

"While all taxes impede economic growth to one extent or another, the capital gains tax in my judgement is at the far end of the scale," he told the Senate Banking Committee in semi-annual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
He said the appropriate capital gains tax was zero but short of that any cuts and "especially indexing would be in my judgement an act that would be appropriate policy for this Congress."
